definitions.explanation: The capacity to adjust to new conditions, environments, or situations. Used for both people and organisms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{適応力|てきおうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{適応力|てきおうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Children are said to be more adaptable than adults.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{適応力|てきおうりょく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Overseas assignments require not only language skills but also the ability to adapt to different cultures.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{適応|てきおう}→適応：14382_tekiou⟧ (adaptation) and {力|りょく} (power, ability). Follows the productive Japanese pattern of adding {力|りょく} to abstract nouns to form 'ability to X.'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順応力|じゅんのうりょく} is a close synonym, slightly more passive
- ⟦{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}→柔軟性：05796_juunansei⟧ means flexibility, a related quality

- {適応力|てきおうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (highly adaptable)
